summary: David lies with Bathsheba, and she conceives—He then arranges for the death in battle of her husband, Uriah.
meta_description: David lies with Bathsheba, and she conceives—He then arranges for the death in battle of her husband, Uriah.

footnotes.note3_a: HEB Daughter of the covenant. 1 Chr. 3:5.
footnotes.note3_b: HEB Jehovah is my light. 1 Kgs. 15:5; 1 Chr. 11:41.
footnotes.note8_a: IE a present of a portion of food. Gen. 43:34.
footnotes.note20_a: Joab had not followed the king’s plan (see v. 15) but sent Uriah and his men right up to the city gate and wall. He feared David might be angry because so many were killed with Uriah.
